description: This file defines a PHP class `Jjwg_MarkersViewMarker_Edit_Map` that extends SugarView. The class renders an HTML page with embedded JavaScript for a Google Maps-based marker editing interface, including map initialization, marker dragging, geocoding, and updating parent frame form fields.

classes.name: Jjwg_MarkersViewMarker_Edit_Map
classes.description: A view class in SugarCRM that renders a Google Map for editing marker locations and details within the module.
